name: wos-dr
description: Workflow OS disaster recovery snapshots for WOS setup, memory, task/project continuity, and OneDrive-backed restore points.

interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Disaster Recovery creates OneDrive-backed snapshots of WOS-owned setup state, local memory, task and project receipts, active pointers, plugin versions, and project marker inventories. Restore is explicit and user-confirmed.
defaultPrompt: Set up WOS disaster recovery snapshots.
